mapper.sql: SELECT sa.id, sa.schedule_id, sa.worker_id, sa.status, sa.applied_at, sa.updated_at, js.job_id, j.title AS job_title, j.company_id AS company_id, e.company_name, w.name AS worker_name, w.phone AS worker_phone, sa.updated_at AS reviewed_at FROM schedule_applications sa JOIN job_schedules js ON sa.schedule_id = js.id JOIN jobs j ON js.job_id = j.id LEFT JOIN enterprises e ON j.company_id = e.id LEFT JOIN c_worker w ON sa.worker_id = w.id
mapper.select: WHERE js.job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY sa.applied_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE schedule_applications SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
